title: USF-223 backup restore DR PITR and RPO/RTO execution proof

executionProofBoundaries.whatIsProven: A profile-gated local Compose proof starts synthetic Postgres with WAL archiving enabled, creates a pgBackRest online full backup while Postgres is running, and observes at least one archived WAL file.
executionProofBoundaries.whatIsNotProven: This does not prove no backup readiness, restore readiness, environment promotion, provider-managed operation, live-provider, staging, production, SOC, ISO, full dev, full product readiness, or USF-133 closure claim is made.
executionProofBoundaries.nonEquivalenceBoundary: Local online backup and local WAL archive evidence are not equivalent to managed backup operation, environment-promotion backup gates, production backup operation, or live-provider backup service evidence.

executionProofBoundaries.whatIsProven: The proof dispatches a deterministic local scheduled-backup operation as a second pgBackRest backup, creates a restore point, restores into an isolated volume, replays archived WAL to the target, and verifies the post-target mutation is absent.
executionProofBoundaries.whatIsNotProven: This does not prove no scheduler service readiness, provider-managed schedule operation, PITR readiness, restore readiness, staging, production, live-provider, SOC, ISO, full dev, full product readiness, or USF-133 closure claim is made.
executionProofBoundaries.nonEquivalenceBoundary: A deterministic local scheduled dispatch is not equivalent to a production scheduler, managed backup plan, operator runbook rehearsal, or environment promotion gate.

executionProofBoundaries.whatIsProven: The proof stops the source Postgres before restore, restores to a fresh isolated volume, captures local RPO/RTO observation buckets, proves missing repository fail-closed behaviour, and tears down Compose resources and temporary directories.
executionProofBoundaries.whatIsNotProven: This does not prove no DR readiness, RPO target achievement, RTO target achievement, production incident runbook, provider-managed DR, staging, production, live-provider, SOC, ISO, full dev, full product readiness, or USF-133 closure claim is made.
executionProofBoundaries.nonEquivalenceBoundary: Local failure rehearsal and local duration/count observations are not equivalent to target-backed RPO/RTO commitments, production DR exercise, customer-impact assessment, or live-provider disaster recovery evidence.

remainingDeferredBoundaries.nonClaimBoundary: USF-223 does not prove test, staging, production, deployment, live-provider, SOC, ISO, enterprise production, full dev, full product readiness, or USF-133 closure readiness.
The local pgBackRest CLI proof does not prove managed supplier operation, live-provider readiness, production operation, SOC readiness, ISO certification, or enterprise production readiness.

operationalEvidence.readinessChecks: Postgres pg_isready and pgBackRest version checks use bounded retry before proof operations.
operationalEvidence.retryTimeoutBehaviour: All Docker, psql, and pgBackRest calls use bounded timeouts; no infinite retry loop is used.
operationalEvidence.failClosedMode: Missing repository proof exits nonzero and is recorded as safe reason code pgbackrest-repository-unavailable.
operationalEvidence.safeTeardown: Restore container, Compose project, named volumes, socket directory, archive directory, and temporary override are removed in finally paths.
operationalEvidence.structuredLogging: Proof output is structured JSON with booleans, buckets, ids, and safe reason codes only.
operationalEvidence.tracingCorrelation: Trace-shaped evidence is recorded as value-free proof metadata; no live tracing backend claim is made.
operationalEvidence.metrics: Metric-shaped evidence records readiness attempts, backup set count, WAL archive count bucket, duration buckets, and cleanup state.
operationalEvidence.auditEvents: Audit-shaped value-free evidence is recorded in the proof result; no production audit log claim is made.
operationalEvidence.redaction: Proof output prohibits secrets, raw endpoints, connection strings, tokens, stack traces, raw provider payloads, table values, backup artifacts, restore payloads, and WAL file names.

evidenceFreshness.retentionPosture: repository metadata and PR validation summaries only; no backup artifacts, restore payloads, database dumps, provider responses, raw endpoints, credentials, tokens, stack traces, WAL file names, or production data are committed
